prompts.ready: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: transparent PNG sprite sheet for a tiny desktop cat pet named Miso. Create exactly EIGHT chronological animation poses in FOUR columns and TWO rows, equal square cells, no gutters, requested canvas 1536 x 768. A compact friendly cream-and-rust orange tabby kitten with pointed triangular ears, cream muzzle/chest/front paws, three dark rust forehead stripes, small dark chocolate eyes and nose, pink inner ears, thick dark brown pixel outline, short chunky body, curled striped tail on its right. No collar or accessories. Pixel-art game sprite style, deliberate blocky pixels, limited warm palette, crisp silhouette, simple flat shading, three-quarter front view. Same identity, scale and proportions across all frames. Each cell has the full cat with ample transparent margin, head centered at 50% cell width, resting paws at 82% cell height. Keep the cat roughly 62% of cell height to leave headroom for future jumps. Idle animation: 1 neutral seated cat eyes open, 2 slight tail tip sweep left, 3 tail tip sweep right, 4 eyes half closed, 5 eyes closed blink, 6 eyes reopening, 7 tail returning with gentle breathing, 8 exact return toward neutral seated pose. Body and paws stay planted in the same place, only subtle breathing, blink and tail motion. Frame order left-to-right top-to-bottom. Actual transparent background and transparent gaps around tail/legs. No text, labels, grid lines, ground shadow, props, scenery, checkerboard, extra limbs, clipping, camera movement or character size changes. This sheet establishes the canonical identity for the remaining cat animations.
